Name: NASCAR Tracker
Author: Packrat

Actions.Name: Next Race
Actions.Tooltip: The next race and a countdown once it is close. Press to refresh.

Actions.Name: Race Field
Actions.Tooltip: The running order, one driver at a time. Press for the next position.

Actions.Name: Driver Standings
Actions.Tooltip: The championship table, one driver at a time. Press to walk down the order.

Description: Race day on your deck. The next race, the running order, and the championship table, updating on their own while you play or stream. No alt-tabbing to check the race. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NASCAR, any team or any driver.
